questions.prompt: A school has 1,250 students. Each needs 4 notebooks. How many notebooks in all?
A train travels 1,386 km on day 1 and 947 km on day 2. How far altogether (km)?
How many thousands make one lakh?
Explain why the 3 in 30,000 is worth more than the 3 in 300.
questions.modelAnswer: In 30,000 the 3 is in the ten-thousands place, so it means 3 ten thousands = 30,000. In 300 it is in the hundreds place, so it means only 3 hundreds = 300. Each place is worth ten times the place to its right.
